# Tracking neurons across days with (Deep)UnitMatch

This presentation can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/file/d/12ei4s5pY_5RlfZjwQ3hELCVJit-X9ta4/view?usp=sharing).

It covers:

- why we want to track single neurons across recording days
- how UnitMatch identifies matches using engineered waveform parameters
- how this is validated functionally (inter-spike intervals, natural image responses)
- how DeepUnitMatch replaces the hand-engineered matching step with a trained neural network. 

See the [coding chapter](unitmatch-coding.qmd) for the accompanying hands-on exercises.
